parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic. It is a long, thin component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It provides support and stability, holding the glasses in place on the wearer’s head by resting over the ear.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the opposite side of the head, ensuring balance and comfort during wear.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the structural base for attaching the legs. It also ensures proper alignment with the wearer’s eyes.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the central rigid structure to which the legs are hinged.
